其实原因很简单，也很纯粹：
一是想给一直支持我们的玩家，留一个"可以持续游玩的地方"。不用再担心服务器关闭，某天突然就玩不到了，这份陪伴不该被运营问题打断；

从网游到单机，这是一次艰难的转型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我们深知这款游戏还不够完美，但它始终承载着"不让热爱落幕"的初心。如果你是老玩家，欢迎回来重拾回忆；如果你喜欢暗黑地牢类游戏，也期待你能来探索这个世界。
下面和大家详细说说单机版的核心改动，每一处都为了更纯粹的游玩体验：
1、彻底删除所有氪金系统，买断制一次付费，畅玩到底；

5、角色永久死亡：一旦阵亡无法复活、无法重招，每一步选择都要谨慎；
6、即时存档功能：随开随玩；
7、装备系统优化：提升罗盘秘境产出，降低装备打磨成本和火炼难度，减负更护肝。
我们知道，这次转型可能会有不完美的地方，但每一处改动都凝聚着我们的诚意。老玩家们，这里依然是你们熟悉的安尼姆，却有了更纯粹的冒险；新朋友们，欢迎你们加入这场旅途。

Compare multiple scenario options to determine which retirement option is best for you.

Specifically, Military Retirement will calculate
• RETIREMENT PAY : Based on Rank, Years and Months of Service, and Date of Retirement. Also works for time in rank of less than 3 years.
• SURVIVOR BENEFIT PLAN : Benefit and Premium
• TRICARE MEDICAL INSURANCE : Options and Premium
• DISABILITY PAY : Based on disability rating
• VETERANS GROUP LIFE INSURANCE : Coverage and Premium
• FEDERAL TAXES : Based on filing status

** Note **
Information provided by Military Retirement should be used for educational and initial informative purposes only. Should not be used to plan retirement budget, as actual financial figures may slightly differ.
Military Retirement supports retirement dates from 2012 onwards.

mo.description:
致所有熱愛《安尼姆》的玩家：
這一次，我們做了款永不落幕的單機版！
各位新老玩家朋友們，好久不見。
為什麼我們要把《安尼姆的無盡旅途》從網游改成單機版？
其實原因很簡單，也很純粹：
一是想給一直支持我們的玩家，留一個「可以持續遊玩的地方」。不用再擔心服務器關閉，某天突然就玩不到了，這份陪伴不該被運營問題打斷；
二是想彌補遺憾。網游版的運營一直舉步維艱，更讓我們愧疚的是，當初的設計框架導致遊戲體驗不夠穩定，這些問題困擾了大家很久，也成了我們心裡的疙瘩。所以我們想在最後，把遊戲最基礎、最核心的體驗做好，完整地交到喜歡《安尼姆》的人手裡。這是我們項目組能做，也應該做的事。
從網游到單機，這是一次艱難的轉型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我們深知這款遊戲還不夠完美，但它始終承載著「不讓熱愛落幕」的初心。如果你是老玩家，歡迎回來重拾回憶；如果你喜歡暗黑地牢類遊戲，也期待你能來探索這個世界。
下面和大家詳細說說單機版的核心改動，每一處都為了更純粹的遊玩體驗：
徹底刪除所有氪金系統，買斷制一次付費，暢玩到底；
新增「遊戲月」機制：替代原網游24小時現實刷新，主線需在倒計時內完成（簡單/普通難度時間充裕，高難度更具挑戰），同時承載遊戲內刷新功能；
角色全免費招募：取消固定角色徽章，改為通用徽章升級，招募與升級方式需要大家自行探索；
新增旁白系統：強化劇情沉浸感，帶你更深入走進安尼姆的世界；
角色永久死亡：一旦陣亡無法復活、無法重招，每一步選擇都要謹慎；
即時存檔功能：隨開隨玩；
裝備系統優化：提升羅盤秘境產出，降低裝備打磨成本和火煉難度，減負更護肝。
我們知道，這次轉型可能會有不完美的地方，但每一處改動都凝聚著我們的誠意。老玩家們，這裡依然是你們熟悉的安尼姆，卻有了更純粹的冒險；新朋友們，歡迎你們加入這場旅途。

致所有熱愛《安尼姆》的玩家：
這一次，我們做了款永不落幕的單機版！
各位新老玩家朋友們，好久不見。
為什麼我們要把《安尼姆的無盡旅途》從網游改成單機版？
其實原因很簡單，也很純粹：
一是想給一直支持我們的玩家，留一個「可以持續遊玩的地方」。不用再擔心服務器關閉，某天突然就玩不到了，這份陪伴不該被運營問題打斷；
二是想彌補遺憾。網游版的運營一直舉步維艱，更讓我們愧疚的是，當初的設計框架導致遊戲體驗不夠穩定，這些問題困擾了大家很久，也成了我們心裡的疙瘩。所以我們想在最後，把遊戲最基礎、最核心的體驗做好，完整地交到喜歡《安尼姆》的人手裡。這是我們項目組能做，也應該做的事。
從網游到單機，這是一次艱難的轉型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我們深知這款遊戲還不夠完美，但它始終承載著「不讓熱愛落幕」的初心。如果你是老玩家，歡迎回來重拾回憶；如果你喜歡暗黑地牢類遊戲，也期待你能來探索這個世界。
下面和大家詳細說說單機版的核心改動，每一處都為了更純粹的遊玩體驗：
徹底刪除所有氪金系統，買斷制一次付費，暢玩到底；
新增「遊戲月」機制：替代原網游24小時現實刷新，主線需在倒計時內完成（簡單/普通難度時間充裕，高難度更具挑戰），同時承載遊戲內刷新功能；
角色全免費招募：取消固定角色徽章，改為通用徽章升級，招募與升級方式需要大家自行探索；
新增旁白系統：強化劇情沉浸感，帶你更深入走進安尼姆的世界；
角色永久死亡：一旦陣亡無法復活、無法重招，每一步選擇都要謹慎；
即時存檔功能：隨開隨玩；
裝備系統優化：提升羅盤秘境產出，降低裝備打磨成本和火煉難度，減負更護肝。
我們知道，這次轉型可能會有不完美的地方，但每一處改動都凝聚著我們的誠意。老玩家們，這裡依然是你們熟悉的安尼姆，卻有了更純粹的冒險；新朋友們，歡迎你們加入這場旅途。

Play the ultimate digital version of the multi-award-winning modern classic board game Ticket to Ride! 

Journey across various countries, connecting their vibrant cities and exploring their unique gameplay mechanics and bonuses on the way. 

Ticket to Ride offers a variety of game modes to suit you. Want to get competitive? Head online to challenge other players around the world and climb the leaderboards, or play with friends further afield in a private game. Got a packed schedule? Set up or join an asynchronous game and play across multiple days – we’ll notify you when it is your turn, so you can go at your own pace. 

Test out new strategies or keep it casual in single-player mode against state-of-the-art AI opponents. You can even make a game night of it with friends and family in couch play!

Get to know a cast of unforgettable characters, each bringing their own tales to the table. Add new locomotives and carriages to your fleet with every expansion, and cement your name in railway history on the leaderboard! 

Become a railway legend in the iconic, fan-favourite modern classic!


HOW TO PLAY TICKET TO RIDE®:

Players are dealt a number of tickets and must pick a certain number to keep (depending on the map). 
Players are also dealt four train cards of various colours. This number can also vary depending on the map you’re playing on, but don’t worry – the AI takes care of this!
Each turn, players can draw two train cards from the face-up pile, draw two train cards from the face-down pile, draw another ticket to complete, or use their train cards to claim a route! A claimed route is shown by placing train pieces along the route.
When a player has three or fewer train pieces left, the last round starts. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner! 


FEATURES
A TRULY SOCIAL TAKE ON MULTIPLAYER – Play online with friends or enjoy a seamless matchmaking experience when you challenge players from around the world. Alternatively, take on your friend sitting right next to you in couch play – use the free Ticket to Ride Companion App to really boost your couch gaming session!
PLAY AROUND YOUR BUSY DAY – Set up a game in async mode and play a game across multiple days.
SINGLE-PLAYER MODE DRIVEN BY EXPERT AIs – Powered by an innovative adaptive AI system, single-player mode offers a challenge for new and experienced players alike. 
AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE – Every moment has been brought to life with beautiful graphics that will immerse you in the adventure. 
STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY – Every game presents fresh challenges, and it’s your mission to work out the most efficient solutions. Collect points by completing tickets, linking destinations and building the longest route.

Join the Marmalade Game Studio Discord server to connect with players, organise matches, see the latest news and updates, and take part in events!

us.description:
To every player who loves DongWu: This time, we made a single-player version that never ends.
Dear old friends and new adventurers — it’s been a while.
Why did we turn DongWu Odyssey from an online game into a single-player title?
The reason is simple, and honestly, quite pure.
First, we wanted to give the players who’ve always supported us a place to keep playing — forever. No more worrying about the servers shutting down, no more waking up one day to find you can’t log in. This companionship shouldn’t be cut short by operational problems.
Second, we wanted to make things right. The online version struggled to stay afloat, and what weighs on us even more is that the original design framework led to an unstable experience. Those issues troubled all of you for far too long, and they’ve been a knot in our hearts ever since. So we decided that, at the very end, we would nail the most fundamental, core experience of the game and hand it over, fully and completely, to everyone who loves DongWu. This is something our team can do, and something we should do.
From online to single-player — this is a difficult transformation, but also a brave rebirth. We know this game is still far from perfect, yet it has always carried the original intention of "never letting passion fade." If you’re a returning player, welcome back to relive your memories. If you love Darkest Dungeon-style games, we hope you’ll come explore this world.
Here are the core changes in the single-player version — every one of them made for a more pure playing experience:
All monetization removed. Pay once, play forever. No gacha, no stamina, no microtransactions.
New "Game Month" system: Replaces the old 24-hour real-time refresh cycle. Main story progress must be completed within a countdown timer (Easy/Normal difficulties are forgiving; Hard mode truly tests you). Also handles in-game refresh functions.
All characters freely recruitable: Fixed character badges are gone. Now a universal badge system handles upgrades — how to recruit and level up is for you to discover.
New narrator system: Deepens story immersion and pulls you deeper into the world of DongWu.
Permanent death: Once a character falls, they’re gone for good — no resurrection, no re-recruitment. Every step demands caution.
Instant save: Pick up and play whenever you want.
Gear system overhaul: Increased(Compass Maze) drops, reduced equipment polishing costs, and lowered refining difficulty — less grind, more fun.
We know this transformation won’t be perfect. But every change was made with sincerity. Old friends, this is still the DongWu you know — only now with a purer adventure. New friends, welcome to the journey.

To every player who loves DongWu: This time, we made a single-player version that never ends.
Dear old friends and new adventurers — it’s been a while.
Why did we turn DongWu Odyssey from an online game into a single-player title?
The reason is simple, and honestly, quite pure.
First, we wanted to give the players who’ve always supported us a place to keep playing — forever. No more worrying about the servers shutting down, no more waking up one day to find you can’t log in. This companionship shouldn’t be cut short by operational problems.
Second, we wanted to make things right. The online version struggled to stay afloat, and what weighs on us even more is that the original design framework led to an unstable experience. Those issues troubled all of you for far too long, and they’ve been a knot in our hearts ever since. So we decided that, at the very end, we would nail the most fundamental, core experience of the game and hand it over, fully and completely, to everyone who loves DongWu. This is something our team can do, and something we should do.
From online to single-player — this is a difficult transformation, but also a brave rebirth. We know this game is still far from perfect, yet it has always carried the original intention of "never letting passion fade." If you’re a returning player, welcome back to relive your memories. If you love Darkest Dungeon-style games, we hope you’ll come explore this world.
Here are the core changes in the single-player version — every one of them made for a more pure playing experience:
All monetization removed. Pay once, play forever. No gacha, no stamina, no microtransactions.
New "Game Month" system: Replaces the old 24-hour real-time refresh cycle. Main story progress must be completed within a countdown timer (Easy/Normal difficulties are forgiving; Hard mode truly tests you). Also handles in-game refresh functions.
All characters freely recruitable: Fixed character badges are gone. Now a universal badge system handles upgrades — how to recruit and level up is for you to discover.
New narrator system: Deepens story immersion and pulls you deeper into the world of DongWu.
Permanent death: Once a character falls, they’re gone for good — no resurrection, no re-recruitment. Every step demands caution.
Instant save: Pick up and play whenever you want.
Gear system overhaul: Increased(Compass Maze) drops, reduced equipment polishing costs, and lowered refining difficulty — less grind, more fun.
We know this transformation won’t be perfect. But every change was made with sincerity. Old friends, this is still the DongWu you know — only now with a purer adventure. New friends, welcome to the journey.

tr.description:
Play the ultimate digital version of the multi-award-winning modern classic board game Ticket to Ride! 

Journey across various countries, connecting their vibrant cities and exploring their unique gameplay mechanics and bonuses on the way. 

Ticket to Ride offers a variety of game modes to suit you. Want to get competitive? Head online to challenge other players around the world and climb the leaderboards, or play with friends further afield in a private game. Got a packed schedule? Set up or join an asynchronous game and play across multiple days – we’ll notify you when it is your turn, so you can go at your own pace. 

Test out new strategies or keep it casual in single-player mode against state-of-the-art AI opponents. You can even make a game night of it with friends and family in couch play!

Get to know a cast of unforgettable characters, each bringing their own tales to the table. Add new locomotives and carriages to your fleet with every expansion, and cement your name in railway history on the leaderboard! 

Become a railway legend in the iconic, fan-favourite modern classic!


HOW TO PLAY TICKET TO RIDE®:

Players are dealt a number of tickets and must pick a certain number to keep (depending on the map). 
Players are also dealt four train cards of various colours. This number can also vary depending on the map you’re playing on, but don’t worry – the AI takes care of this!
Each turn, players can draw two train cards from the face-up pile, draw two train cards from the face-down pile, draw another ticket to complete, or use their train cards to claim a route! A claimed route is shown by placing train pieces along the route.
When a player has three or fewer train pieces left, the last round starts. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner! 


FEATURES
A TRULY SOCIAL TAKE ON MULTIPLAYER – Play online with friends or enjoy a seamless matchmaking experience when you challenge players from around the world. Alternatively, take on your friend sitting right next to you in couch play – use the free Ticket to Ride Companion App to really boost your couch gaming session!
PLAY AROUND YOUR BUSY DAY – Set up a game in async mode and play a game across multiple days.
SINGLE-PLAYER MODE DRIVEN BY EXPERT AIs – Powered by an innovative adaptive AI system, single-player mode offers a challenge for new and experienced players alike. 
AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE – Every moment has been brought to life with beautiful graphics that will immerse you in the adventure. 
STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY – Every game presents fresh challenges, and it’s your mission to work out the most efficient solutions. Collect points by completing tickets, linking destinations and building the longest route.

Join the Marmalade Game Studio Discord server to connect with players, organise matches, see the latest news and updates, and take part in events!

pt.description:
致所有热爱《安尼姆》的玩家：
这一次，我们做了款永不落幕的单机版！
各位新老玩家朋友们，好久不见。
为什么我们要把《安尼姆的无尽旅途》从网游改成单机版？
其实原因很简单，也很纯粹：
一是想给一直支持我们的玩家，留一个"可以持续游玩的地方"。不用再担心服务器关闭，某天突然就玩不到了，这份陪伴不该被运营问题打断；
二是想弥补遗憾。网游版的运营一直举步维艰，更让我们愧疚的是，当初的设计框架导致游戏体验不够稳定，这些问题困扰了大家很久，也成了我们心里的疙瘩。所以我们想在最后，把游戏最基础、最核心的体验做好，完整地交到喜欢《安尼姆》的人手里。这是我们项目组能做，也应该做的事。
从网游到单机，这是一次艰难的转型，也是一次勇敢的重生。我们深知这款游戏还不够完美，但它始终承载着"不让热爱落幕"的初心。如果你是老玩家，欢迎回来重拾回忆；如果你喜欢暗黑地牢类游戏，也期待你能来探索这个世界。
下面和大家详细说说单机版的核心改动，每一处都为了更纯粹的游玩体验：
1、彻底删除所有氪金系统，买断制一次付费，畅玩到底；
2、新增"游戏月"机制：替代原网游24小时现实刷新，主线需在倒计时内完成（简单/普通难度时间充裕，高难度更具挑战），同时承载游戏内刷新功能；
3、角色全免费招募：取消固定角色徽章，改为通用徽章升级，招募与升级方式需要大家自行探索；
4、新增旁白系统：强化剧情沉浸感，带你更深入走进安尼姆的世界；
5、角色永久死亡：一旦阵亡无法复活、无法重招，每一步选择都要谨慎；
6、即时存档功能：随开随玩；
7、装备系统优化：提升罗盘秘境产出，降低装备打磨成本和火炼难度，减负更护肝。
我们知道，这次转型可能会有不完美的地方，但每一处改动都凝聚着我们的诚意。老玩家们，这里依然是你们熟悉的安尼姆，却有了更纯粹的冒险；新朋友们，欢迎你们加入这场旅途。

Military Retirement is a stand alone application intended to assist military personnel from all branches of military service by informing them of their benefits upon retirement from military service. Military Retirement gives assistance by calculating an estimation of retirement pay based on the data you enter. This data is secure and does not leave your device and is not tracked in any way. Military Retirement incorporates highly detailed algorithms to calculate your retirement pay to the highest level of accuracy possible. Compare multiple scenario options to determine which retirement option is best for you. 

No login required. No personally identifying information to enter. No demographic tracking of who you are. No spam.

Military Retirement works for Active Duty and Reserve/Guard for the following types of retirement plans: Final Pay, High-3, BRS, and CSB/REDUX personnel. 

Specifically, Military Retirement will calculate
• RETIREMENT PAY : Based on Rank, Years and Months of Service, and Date of Retirement. Also works for time in rank of less than 3 years.
• SURVIVOR BENEFIT PLAN : Benefit and Premium
• TRICARE MEDICAL INSURANCE : Options and Premium
• DISABILITY PAY : Based on disability rating
• VETERANS GROUP LIFE INSURANCE : Coverage and Premium
• FEDERAL TAXES : Based on filing status

** Note **
Information provided by Military Retirement should be used for educational and initial informative purposes only. Should not be used to plan retirement budget, as actual financial figures may slightly differ.
Military Retirement supports retirement dates from 2012 onwards.

Overview


DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince comes to smartphones!

Compose your very own team of monsters from across the Dragon Quest series and engage in thrilling battles against your foes. Recruit monsters from the wild world around you and combine them to synthesize new creatures as you see fit. With over 500 monsters to choose from and a revamped synthesis system to explore, you can mix and match to you heart's content to create your favorite cute critters and dastardly supervillains, as well as brand-new additions to the monstrous roll call.

Your quest to become the greatest monster wrangler of all time starts here!



Story


This is the tale of Psaro, a young man cursed, and the adventure upon which he and his trusted friends embark.

When the curse put upon him by his father, the Master of Monsterkind, renders him incapable of harming any creature of monster blood, Psaro vows to become a monster wrangler in order to break the spell. On his journey, he will befriend many monsters, train them to be stronger, synthesize powerful new allies and take on ever more dangerous foes.

Join Psaro and his friends on their campaign for monster-wrangling glory!

(The network mode Online Battles from the console version, where players battle one another in real time, is not included.)



Game Features


- Explore Nadiria, the Magical Monster Realm
On his quest for greatness, Psaro will traverse the multifarious Circles of Nadiria. Whether it be made entirely of cake and sweets or fraught with rivers of bubbling lava, each Circle plays host to a wealth of bewitching adventures. As time passes in Nadiria, so too do the seasons change, with different weather conditions tempting new monsters out of hiding and revealing paths to undiscovered areas. The Circles of Nadiria are sure to provide a fresh experience every time you visit.


- Over 500 Unique Monsters
With such varied environments to explore, you can expect them to be inhabited by a plethora of monsters. While many can be recruited in battle, occasionally a defeated monster will ask to join your team of its own accord. Befriend as many monsters as you can, then combine them to synthesize new creatures and build a unique party to your exact liking. 


- Enjoy All the DLC from the Console Version
The smartphone version includes the DLC packs from the console version: the Mole Hole, Coach Joe's Dungeon Gym and Treasure Trunks. Make the most of their unique features to enhance your adventure.


- Test Your Might Against Other Players
Register your team for the network mode Quickfire Contests to participate in automated battles against the party data of 30 other players. Once a day you can earn stat-boosting items as a prize, and the monsters from any team you defeat will be added to your roster (up to rank B monsters only).



Recommended Device Specifications

- iPhone 11 or later
- iPad (10th generation) or later
- iPad mini (6th generation) or later
- iPad Air (5th generation) or later
- iPad Pro (4th generation) or later

Graphics settings can be adjusted to improve performance. Running the game on devices that do not meet the recommended specifications can result in crashes due to insufficient memory, or other unexpected errors. We are unable to provide support for devices that do not meet the recommended specifications.



OS Compatibility

iOS 13.0 or later

Nosso herói começa a história como um garotinho, viajando pelo mundo com seu pai, Pankraz.
Ao longo de suas muitas aventuras, esse adorável rapaz aprende e cresce.
E quando finalmente se torna um homem, ele decide continuar a busca inacabada de seu pai: encontrar o Herói Lendário...
